description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller that handles file uploads for importing book data from LibraryThing into the application. It defines an endpoint '/api/import/library-thing' which processes multipart form data, deserializes JSON content into internal data structures, and delegates the import processing to a service.

classes.name: BookImportController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for importing book data from LibraryThing via multipart file upload. It parses the JSON content into internal data structures and calls the import service delegate.

methods.name: importFromLibraryThing
methods.description: Handles POST requests to import book data from a LibraryThing JSON file, deserializes JSON into Java objects, and delegates processing to the import service.
